subject.title: fix: keep tail alive and replay timed-out messages

question: What repeated-failure policy should convert nonfatal tail handler errors back into a fatal tail condition?
rationale: The appropriate consecutive-failure count, time window, and reset condition are operational policy choices that affect watchdog behavior and cannot be selected safely from tests alone.

options.title: Bounded circuit breaker
options.body: Continue isolated failures but terminate after a documented threshold of repeated handler failures, resetting the threshold after successful processing.

options.title: Log-only continuation
options.body: Allow indefinite continuation and explicitly accept that operators must detect a functionally dead tail through logs or failure-ledger monitoring.

options.title: Preserve universal fail-fast
options.body: Keep every handler failure fatal, retaining current watchdog semantics but giving up the PR's transient-failure availability improvement.

recommendation.title: Bounded circuit breaker
recommendation.body: Continue isolated failures but terminate after a documented threshold of repeated handler failures, resetting the threshold after successful processing.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed tail behavior and have prior released history in the adjacent Discord sync correctness paths.
